name: Mail Desk
description: A focused read-only desk over the local index: search, browse and read plain-text, with deep links. Index-only - attachments and rich mail HTML are not read, and nothing is ever moved or sent.

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Search the local mail index by sender, subject or snippet. Returns a capped result list; used by the Mail Desk browser page.

tools.name: read_message
tools.description: Read one indexed message by id (headers, category, tags, plain text). Used by the Mail Desk browser page.

pages.title: Mail Desk
pages.description: Search and read the local mail index
